# Documentation

Update documentation when behavior, setup, commands, or project structure changes.

- Match the existing README tone and keep instructions copy-pasteable.
- Document prerequisites, development commands, test commands, and Unity/WebGL build steps when relevant.
- Prefer short explanations of why a workflow exists over restating implementation details.
- Link to source files or scripts only when the path is stable and helpful.
- Do not create planning notes or duplicate documentation for a one-line implementation detail.
